title: Vinod Khosla believes ex-DeepMind engineer’s Wajo will win agent market on trust
slides: Can Wajo beat billion-dollar agent giants on trust?
Vinod Khosla just backed ex-DeepMind engineer's startup.
But Wajo's real weapon isn't the model itself.
You'll soon choose agent trust over raw benchmarks.
Test one agent on a real task this week.
thread_text:
1. Trust vs. Giants

Vinod Khosla just backed an ex-DeepMind engineer's startup. Can a small team beat billion-dollar agent giants on trust alone?

2. The Real Weapon

Wajo's edge isn't the underlying model. It's how the agent proves reliability on real tasks, not benchmarks.

3. Benchmarks Are Lying

Raw scores don't predict real-world performance. Soon you'll pick agents based on trust, not leaderboard rankings.

4. One Task Test

Take a single real task this week and run it through one agent. See if it actually delivers without hand-holding.

5. Your Turn

Which agent do you trust with your work today? Test one on a real post this week. If it fails, you'll know why trust matters.
